title: Issues with Email Routing in France

timeline.body: Cloudflare is investigating issues with Email Routing in France. Some SPF records may intermittently fail to resolve. Impact is restricted to email forwarding functionality and does not affect any connectivity, security, CDN or Area1 functionality, nor does it affect Email Routing outside of France. We are working to mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: We are continuing to work on a fix for the issue.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
timeline.label: monitoring
